change_readonly_mode: Read-only task protection: {before} -> {after}. sandbox keeps existing runtime protection (Codex uses a read-only sandbox; Claude uses instructions). prompt uses instructions only, not a security boundary; normal runtime permissions still apply. Applies to new task starts and retries, not running agents. Switch back to sandbox to restore the default.

change_meeting_transcription_default: Meeting transcription: {before} → {after}, for meetings started from now on. In hub mode, the meeting’s audio is sent to the hub’s transcription service. The hub deletes the audio once the minutes are written.
meeting_transcription_not_ready: Meeting transcription: {before} → {after}, for meetings started from now on. In hub mode, the meeting’s audio is sent to the hub’s transcription service. The hub deletes the audio once the minutes are written. Hub transcription isn’t ready yet; the start sheet offers it only once it is ready.
meeting_transcription_no_database: This hub has no database. Connect a database before changing the meeting transcription default.
meeting_transcription_unchanged: The meeting transcription default is unchanged.
meeting_transcription_applied: Meeting transcription is set to {mode} for meetings started from now on.
change_task_trust_add_edit: From now on, tasks that change files on {machine} in {directory} and its subfolders start right away, without a plan card
change_task_trust_add_read: From now on, tasks that only read files on {machine} in {directory} and its subfolders start right away, without a plan card
change_task_trust_remove_edit: Tasks that change files on {machine} in {directory} wait for Start on a plan card again
change_task_trust_remove_read: Tasks that only read files on {machine} in {directory} are no longer remembered (read-only tasks still start right away)
bad_idle_auto_compact: Value must be true or false.
bad_idle_auto_compact_minutes: Choose a whole number from 1 to 1440 minutes.
bad_idle_auto_compact_tokens: Choose a whole number from 10000 to 10000000 tokens.
title_idle_release_minutes: Main chat stays loaded when idle
change_idle_release_minutes: Main chat stays loaded when idle: {before} → {after} minutes
bad_idle_release_minutes: Choose a whole number from 5 to 55 minutes.
idle_release_saved: Saved. It applies from the main chat’s next message.
change_supervision_batch_minutes: Routine supervision batching per recipient: {before} → {after} minutes (0 keeps the existing cadence)
bad_supervision_batch_minutes: Choose a whole number from 0 to 1440 minutes.
supervision_batch_minutes_unchanged: The routine supervision batch interval is unchanged.
supervision_batch_minutes_saved: Routine supervision batch interval saved as {value} minutes.
